structured.answer: I found it: on the "מדריך" page, under "כסף שוטף וקצר", there's a box for "תכנית חיסכון" (money you put into the bank now and then, e.g. by monthly standing order, for an agreed period at interest) right next to "פיקדון". But I only got that one line. I didn't see the page behind it with the costs and tax, so I'll ask my son or the bank about the rest.

stuck.why: It opens with a goal form (דירה, חתונה, ₪ boxes), not with deposits; I had to hunt for the right-hand box "להבין סוג של חיסכון"
"אתר אישי, לא מסחרי": not a bank or a name I know, so I wasn't sure whether to trust it
קרן כספית and מק"מ sit in the same row as פיקדון; I couldn't tell whether they're as safe
All index boxes with English letters. I got tired and stopped there

used: Home title "מקור – להבין חיסכון והשקעה בישראל"
Box "להבין סוג של חיסכון – מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה"
skimmed: Guide sections חיסכון עם הטבת מס, פרישה, לילדים
"לבחירה עצמית" cards (I only noticed אג"ח ממשלתיות)
skipped: Goal form on the home page (בשביל מה, ₪ boxes, מה הכי מתאים)
All מדד cards (S&P 500, MSCI, נאסד"ק, ת"א)
unsure_meaning: מדד in the sense of shares (S&P 500, MSCI World, ת"א-35)
not_found: The full explanation of תכנית חיסכון: what it costs and how it's taxed (only one line on the card)
Whether anything is as safe as a deposit and pays more
Whether the bank is taking too much from me

findings.what: Small grey text on a black background is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Guide: "בכל עמוד של מוצר יש שורה…", "המוצר עצמו…"; home subtitles and footer

findings.what: The home page opens with a form full of ₪ boxes instead of a plain way into deposits and savings
findings.where: Home page, centre box "מה השאלה שלכם?"

findings.what: "אתר אישי, לא מסחרי": an unknown private site, so I'm not sure I can trust it
Boxes all look the same; I had to read each one to find the one I wanted
The same phrase "הכסף מושקע בשקלים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו" repeats on every index card
Unexplained terms (קרן כספית, מק"מ) placed next to the deposit, so I couldn't tell how safe they are
English names (S&P 500, MSCI World) feel like they're not for me
